entries.name: LM Studio
entries.detectionConvention: User-approved models root; publisher/model/file.gguf and validated GGUF v2/v3 header. No API discovery.
entries.evidenceStatus: compiled storage adapter with synthetic contract tests; provider runtime unverified
entries.fallback: Unknown and issue for unrecognized layout, split GGUF, or Safetensors; incomplete for recognized partial artifacts

entries.name: GPT4All
entries.platformStatus: macOS and Apple Silicon Metal documented
entries.detectionConvention: Explicit desktop download directory or Python SDK model path; remote catalog membership is not local installation evidence.
entries.evidenceStatus: official documentation reviewed; local provider-index and API contract fixtures pending
entries.fallback: Manual folder inventory only; no GPT4All ownership or runtime attribution

entries.name: Jan
entries.detectionConvention: Configurable Jan data root, llamacpp/models and mlx/models, model.yml metadata; legacy model.json assumptions are insufficient.
entries.evidenceStatus: official documentation reviewed; versioned YAML, partial-download and API contract fixtures pending
entries.fallback: Manual folder inventory only; no Jan ownership or runtime attribution

entries.name: LocalAI
entries.platformStatus: Native macOS ARM64 binaries documented; backend-specific validation required
entries.detectionConvention: Explicit numeric loopback endpoint, reviewed model mapping and separate provider/process identity. OpenAI API compatibility does not identify LocalAI.
entries.evidenceStatus: official documentation reviewed; health, model-list, authentication and ownership fixtures pending
entries.fallback: Unsupported runtime; no automatic probing, launch, installation or Stop

entries.name: Open WebUI
entries.platformStatus: macOS host documented; browser client independent of inference hardware
entries.detectionConvention: Explicit local UI endpoint and verified provider/model mapping; a connection does not imply local model ownership.
entries.evidenceStatus: official documentation reviewed; authenticated handoff and model-mapping fixtures pending
entries.fallback: Unsupported handoff; never a storage source or an owned inference process
